worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Treatment outside India excluded unless Worldwide IP add-on opted

no_claim_bonus_notes: Multiple optional NCB choices: Cumulative Bonus, NCB Sum Insured, No Claim Discount, Inflation Protect SI
permanent_exclusions: Treatment outside India (unless WW IP cover)
notable_exclusions_summary: Standard IRDAI 16-section exclusions plus permanent exclusions. Maternity, OPD, and worldwide treatment all need explicit add-on cover.
available_riders: Reduction in Specific Illness Waiting Period (Comprehensive/Essential)
claim_process_summary: Cashless or reimbursement; planned cashless 2 days before admission, emergency within 48 hours, pre-auth TAT 1 hour, final TAT 3 hours. Reimbursement within 15 days. Penal interest 2% above bank rate.
